translation: Flavor bitter, slightly poisonous. Its chief actions are to benefit the five viscera, intestines and stomach, supplement blood qi, dispel cold-heat wind-impediment, warm the center, digest grain, treat sore throat, and down-drive ...gu. One name is 利如, one name is 房圖, one name is 白藥, one name is 梗草, one name is 薺 [苨].
